_note: The tokenizers the Latent Lab's language-comparison instrument offers
A table, not code: a model id is data (test_no_model_literals.py).
'id' is the Hugging Face repository the tokenizer files are read from, on the
machine ComfyUI runs on and never from the network; 'label' is a proper noun
and is never translated; 'role' is a key the surface turns into a sentence
about what this tokenizer is to this platform.
CLIP belongs in this list, and not as an afterthought: its window is 77
tokens against Qwen3's 40.960, and that is the whole didactic point - the
text a picture model may read is shorter than one page, and a language that
needs twice as many tokens for the same sentence loses twice as much of it.
